description: The EUMETSAT LSA SAF product page lists Meteosat Second Generation estimates of evapotranspiration, latent heat flux and sensible heat flux over Europe, Africa and eastern South America. It documents 3 km products in HDF5 or NetCDF4, including half-hourly instantaneous fluxes and daily evapotranspiration. A 2004–2020 data record and operational products from 2021 are listed; product versions and continuity differ. EUMETSAT states CC BY 4.0 and free data access after registration. These grids can provide land-surface water and energy boundary conditions for irrigation, drought, agriculture and heat studies. They are satellite-derived estimates, not direct field measurements or local water demand. Cloud, vegetation and model-input uncertainty should be checked in the product documentation before calibration. The historical article describes the MSG-era series, while the provider now lists newer v3 versions. The family complements data-era5-reanalysis with land-surface flux estimates. No account was created and no files were downloaded. The grids are inputs for climate-adaptation simulations of irrigation and land-surface water demand.
